authors: Bob M. Lansdorp, Jennifer M. Gibson, Lior Sepunaru and Kevin W. Plaxco
abstract: Distribution of timescales methods have become powerful tools for extracting hidden kinetic processes from <mark>electrochemical impedance</mark> spectra. Their physical interpretation, however, depends critically on matching the assumed mathematical model to the underlying physical electrochemical system. Here, we show that the Distribution of Capacitive Times (DCT) model is well-matched to the physics of surface-immobilized redox systems, enabling electron-transfer rate heterogeneity to be resolved.
